recentItems.description:
The espionage controversy surrounding American chip giant Nvidia is sending shockwaves through China's artificial intelligence industry. Fearing potential new restrictions from the U.S. government, Chinese tech companies are scrambling to pre-lease Nvidia chip computing capacity through data centers located in third-party countries. This strategic move is seen as a precautionary measure to secure access to critical AI hardware before any additional sanctions can take effect. The development has further intensified the ongoing technology war between the United States and China, raising concerns about the future of global AI competition.

recentItems.title: రష్యా నుంచి ఇంధన కొనుగోళ్లలో భారత్ రికార్డు.. రూ.6.4 బిలియన్ యూరోల దిగుమతులు!
recentItems.description:
Despite ongoing Western sanctions against Russia, India has set a new record in fossil fuel purchases from the country. In October this year, India spent a staggering 6.4 billion euros on Russian energy, making it the second-largest source of revenue for Russia among all nations. The primary driver behind this surge was a significant increase in crude oil imports. These findings were revealed in a report by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air.
